name: Governor Filters precomp bandwidth allows the firmware's 0..250 Hz
step: Check the gov_ff_filter range in the governor config field metadata
rationale: lib/msp_governor_config.lua capped gov_ff_filter at max = 25, while the firmware (src/main/cli/settings.c, {0, 250}) and the Configurator allow 0..250 Hz for the same cutoff. The field now uses max = 250, matching the other filter cutoffs in the table.
